mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, username, pet_type AS petType, content, summary, sentiment, tags, created_date AS createdDate FROM review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
SELECT review_id AS reviewId, username, pet_type AS petType, content, summary, sentiment, tags, created_date AS createdDate FROM review ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (username, pet_type, content, summary, sentiment, tags) VALUES (#{username}, #{petType}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{sentiment}, #{tags})
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET pet_type = #{petType}, content = #{content}, summary = #{summary}, sentiment = #{sentiment}, tags = #{tags} WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
